integrity: The analytical proof is self-contained; the accompanying checker is supplementary and reproduces representative cases without replacing the proof.
limitations: The theorem concerns only pure two-qubit product states, \(N=2\), and the original collective squeezing parameters; the antipodal zero-mean endpoint is a limit rather than a point where the original formulation is defined.
title: Exact pure-product false-positive profile of the original two-qubit Kitagawa–Ueda squeezing parameters
